instruction: Three Zone Clinic Completion. On this machine, launch the OpenStudio application from `/usr/local/bin/OpenStudioApp` and open `init.osm`. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. The starting model already contains the resolved three-space OSM geometry and does not contain an embedded FloorspaceJS-editable floorplan.json; treat the existing OSM surfaces as authoritative and do not attempt to recreate or edit this geometry in FloorspaceJS. Review the Reception, Exam, and Storage spaces, story and zone assignments, zone HVAC equipment lists, paired internal boundaries, and target geometry, then save result.osm in the task output folder. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 3 spaces and 3 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Exam, Reception and Storage. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 19 OS:Surface objects, split into 3 floor surfaces, 3 roof/ceiling surfaces and 13 wall surfaces. The outside-boundary counts must be exactly 3 Ground, 10 Outdoors and 6 Surface: the three floors are Ground; the three roofs and seven exterior walls are Outdoors; and the shared partition pairs are Reception East Wall <-> Exam West Wall, Reception North Wall <-> Surface 1 in Storage, and Exam North Wall <-> Storage South Wall. Both members of every pair must use the Surface outside boundary condition and each member's Outside Boundary Condition Object must reference the other member. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 3 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 10.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 60.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 102.40 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
